## Install

1. Download **Scry-{{VERSION}}.zip** below.
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`, so that `AddOns\Scry\Scry.toc` exists. Updating? Delete the old `Scry` folder first.
3. Restart the game, then make sure **Scry** is ticked in the AddOns list on the character select screen.

Your data (`WTF\Account\<account>\SavedVariables\Scry.lua`) is kept across updates. Type `/scry status` in game to check that it runs.
